newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK ASSETS, RESERVE MONEY UP IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK ASSETS, RESERVE MONEY UP IN MAY.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Friday that its assets and reserve money rose during the month of May.
The bank said in a statement that its assets rose to 3.968 billion litas in May from 3.777 billion litas, an increase of 5.1 percent.
The statement also said that foreign assets rose in the same period by 4.9 percent, to 3.541 billion litas from 3.376 billion litas.
The bank added that its reserve money rose by 5.0 percent to 2.652 billion litas from 2.526 billion litas during the month of May.
